question: Should gateway health formally expose a read-scoped `runtimeConfig` drift diagnostic for restart-pending model, provider, auth, and secret changes?
rationale: This is an additive but operator-visible health API and CLI contract; source review can assess implementation safety, but cannot determine whether this payload should be supported long-term or remain internal diagnostics.

options.title: Sponsor the health diagnostic
options.body: Treat the payload as a supported operator contract, retain scoped sensitive-detail gating, and require current-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep diagnostics internal
options.body: Do not add the new health payload and rely on existing reload status, logs, or a narrower internal diagnostic until a product need is confirmed.

options.title: Narrow the public contract
options.body: Expose only a stable restart-pending state and remediation hint, leaving model labels, path detail, and fingerprints out of the read-scoped payload.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the health diagnostic
recommendation.body: Treat the payload as a supported operator contract, retain scoped sensitive-detail gating, and require current-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged health-status work owns the closest current-main precedent for extending gateway health output and cache-hit freshness.
